newsitem.title: USA: Global chip sales rose slightly in April - SIA.
newsitem.headline: Global chip sales rose slightly in April - SIA.

text.p: Worldwide sales of computer chips rose 1.9 percent in April to $11.12 billion from $10.9 billion in March, according to the Semiconductor Industry Association's monthly report released Thursday.

The trade group said sales in North and South America rose 3.7 percent to $3.8 billion from $3.7 billion in March. Asia Pacific sales rose 3.2 percent to $2.38 billion and European sales rose 1.1 percent to $2.37 billion.
Japan was the only market to show a decline in chip sales last month, falling 1.1 percent to $2.55 billion.
Worldwide, sales of semiconductors were off 5.3 percent from the same period a year ago. The global sales figures are based on a three month rolling average of sales in the world's major markets.
